tools.description: Read active mandate and role-scoped tools. Site work requires exact approval and confirmation.

tools.name: plans.list
tools.description: Read proposed plan contracts; listing does not activate or sell a plan.

tools.name: plan.get_manifest
tools.description: Read compact pinned policy and curated package summaries; use library.get for details when site tools are enabled.

tools.name: plan.get_schemas

tools.name: policy.version

tools.name: library.get
tools.description: Read one curated package, compatibility, status and fictional example props. Does not accept code.

tools.name: starters.list
tools.description: List data-only starting points visible to this principal. Experimental starters require tester classification.

tools.name: starter.get
tools.description: Read a starter seed and English agent guidance, never site copy. Applied once at creation; a different starter requires a new site.

tools.name: site.draft.create
tools.description: Create an incomplete server draft, optionally seeded once from a starter. Starter provenance cannot change; all presentation and content values must be supplied.

tools.name: site.draft.apply
tools.description: Apply an atomic batch up to 32 operations/64 KiB with revision checking. Settings accept owner-supplied shell labels, language and tokens including mono font, motion and layout; sections/blocks accept effects. Supply content only; never code, audience, image bytes, hashes or approvals.

page.description: Page with stable id, path, optional seo and sections; see site schema

section.description: Section with stable id and optional blocks

block.description: Catalog block: id, component, variant, props; see site schema

tools.name: site.draft.get
tools.description: Compact language/token/effect and missing-input/budget summary. Use detail full, assets, or a page ID for content. Assets paginate with after.

tools.name: site.draft.discard
tools.description: Discard this draft, invalidate snapshots and revoke upload sessions.

tools.name: site.upload.open
tools.description: Open one shared agent/human upload session. Agent HTTP + file access requires a tiny probe first; otherwise show the link/QR and wait. Never send bytes through MCP.

tools.name: site.upload.status
tools.description: Read paginated progress for both upload channels; no capability secrets.

tools.name: site.upload.revoke
tools.description: Revoke both channels of this upload session.

tools.name: site.preview
tools.description: Queue server-made verification and screenshots of this complete revision. Deduplicates identical snapshots. Human approval uses the browser link; never MCP.

tools.name: site.status
tools.description: Read only your site, hashes, job results, CMS login URL and UTC change allowance.

tools.name: site.deploy
tools.description: Deploy your verified build to an isolated client project. Confirmation DEPLOY_SITE:<siteId>, or DEPLOY_SITE:<siteId>:<domain> for an initial custom domain. DNS is never modified. cmsPassword is the initial CMS password; encrypted until delivered to Railway and never logged.

tools.name: change.request
tools.description: Unavailable: draft-based changes are deferred. CMS content edits remain available. Every request returns change_requests_unavailable.

tools.name: testers.add
tools.description: Superadmin only: allowlist a free web-simple tester. No message is sent.

tools.name: testers.remove
tools.description: Superadmin only: remove tester eligibility; existing test sites stay test-only. No message is sent.

tools.name: testers.list
tools.description: Superadmin only: list tester eligibility, including disabled entries.

tools.name: logs.query
tools.description: Superadmin only: query redacted audit events, up to 31 days, with bounded pagination; excludes provider logs.

tools.name: sites.list
tools.description: Superadmin only: list sites by test/live classification, owner or status; bounded cursor pagination.

tools.name: site.inspect
tools.description: Superadmin only: inspect status, deployment, hashes and successful/reserved UTC monthly usage. No credentials or client copy.

tools.name: tester.reset
tools.description: Superadmin only: archive a test site and delete its isolated Railway project, PocketBase volume, bucket artifacts and site change history. Requires RESET <siteId>. Busy jobs must finish first; partial cleanup can be retried.

tools.name: site.draft.discard
tools.description: Discard this draft, invalidate snapshots and revoke upload sessions.

tools.name: site.upload.open
tools.description: Open one shared agent/human upload session. Agent HTTP + file access requires a tiny probe first; otherwise show the link/QR and wait. Never send bytes through MCP.

tools.name: site.upload.status
tools.description: Read paginated progress for both upload channels; no capability secrets.

tools.name: site.upload.revoke
tools.description: Revoke both channels of this upload session.

tools.description: Queue server-made verification and screenshots of this complete revision. Deduplicates identical snapshots. Human approval uses the browser link; never MCP.

tools.description: Read only your site, hashes, job results, CMS login URL and UTC change allowance.

tools.name: library.get
tools.description: Read one curated package, compatibility, status and fictional example props. Does not accept code.

tools.name: starters.list
tools.description: List data-only starting points visible to this principal. Experimental starters require tester classification.

tools.name: starter.get
tools.description: Read a starter seed and English agent guidance, never site copy. Applied once at creation; a different starter requires a new site.

tools.name: site.draft.create
tools.description: Create an incomplete server draft, optionally seeded once from a starter. Starter provenance cannot change; all presentation and content values must be supplied.

tools.name: site.draft.apply
tools.description: Apply an atomic batch up to 32 operations/64 KiB with revision checking. Settings accept owner-supplied shell labels, language and tokens including mono font, motion and layout; sections/blocks accept effects. Supply content only; never code, audience, image bytes, hashes or approvals.

page.description: Page with stable id, path, optional seo and sections; see site schema

section.description: Section with stable id and optional blocks

block.description: Catalog block: id, component, variant, props; see site schema

tools.name: site.draft.get
tools.description: Compact language/token/effect and missing-input/budget summary. Use detail full, assets, or a page ID for content. Assets paginate with after.

tools.name: site.draft.discard
tools.description: Discard this draft, invalidate snapshots and revoke upload sessions.

tools.name: site.upload.open
tools.description: Open one shared agent/human upload session. Agent HTTP + file access requires a tiny probe first; otherwise show the link/QR and wait. Never send bytes through MCP.

tools.name: site.upload.status
tools.description: Read paginated progress for both upload channels; no capability secrets.

tools.name: site.upload.revoke
tools.description: Revoke both channels of this upload session.

tools.name: site.preview
tools.description: Queue server-made verification and screenshots of this complete revision. Deduplicates identical snapshots. Human approval uses the browser link; never MCP.

tools.name: site.status
tools.description: Read only your site, hashes, job results, CMS login URL and UTC change allowance.

tools.name: site.deploy
tools.description: Deploy your verified build to an isolated client project. Confirmation DEPLOY_SITE:<siteId>, or DEPLOY_SITE:<siteId>:<domain> for an initial custom domain. DNS is never modified. cmsPassword is the initial CMS password; encrypted until delivered to Railway and never logged.

tools.name: change.request
tools.description: Unavailable: draft-based changes are deferred. CMS content edits remain available. Every request returns change_requests_unavailable.
